6 But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering. For he that wavereth is like a wave of the sea driven with the wind and tossed. 7 For let not that man think that he shall receive any thing of the Lord. (James 1:6-7 KJV)

When we are not consistent in our faith and walk with the Lord, then we cannot expect to reap the benefits of a Christian life. We are to let our light shine (Matthew 5:16), and the best way to do that is to let the love that God has given us (Galatians 5:22-23), flow out to others, as God is love (1 John 4:8).

Therefore we show our love for Him by the way we live our lives without wavering. Just love your neighbor as yourself (Matthew 22:39), and your light will shine. Thank you Lord for giving us your light, so we can shine.
